numeral.purpose: Run total cost in the inspector.

body.purpose: Reading prose on the plate; blocks capped at 60ch.

body-ui.purpose: Interface text and fields; root size 15px (13.5px / 17px by setting).

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase field labels, group names, inspector headings, in dim.

meta.purpose: Plate number, date, version, help text, in dim.

light.description: Light table: every colour token remapped (see colorMeta.*.lightTheme). Selection rgb(155 116 0 / 0.22); float shadow rgb(40 32 10 / 0.28).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, slash menu, toasts, dialogs and off-canvas drawers only.

shadows.name: emission-live
shadows.value: 0 0 10px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 70%, transparent), 0 0 34px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 22%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Glow of a live agent line in its own colour.

shadows.name: emission-done
shadows.purpose: Residual glow of a finished agent line.

shadows.name: doublet
shadows.purpose: Second copy of a line: a fallback model answered. Lines only, never surfaces (3px on the switch needle).

shadows.name: backdrop
shadows.purpose: Dialog backdrop; the drawer scrim uses 0.55.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Things that land: emission lines (0.55s), mark landing (1.1s), switch needle (0.35s). One overshoot.

motion.name: out
motion.purpose: Things that travel: drawers and settings sheet (0.45s), palette (0.3s), toasts (0.4s), wordmark resolve (1.4s), rail draw (1.2s), mark hover split (0.7s).

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Border, background and colour changes on controls.

motion.name: live-blink
motion.purpose: Running run tick and the live agent line in the brand mark.

motion.name: eline-live
motion.purpose: Breathing of a live agent line.

motion.name: sodium-breath
motion.purpose: Idle breathing of the hero mark's sodium doublet.

motion.name: mark-stagger
motion.purpose: Delay step between mark lines on landing (405 to 656 nm).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all animation and transition.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: At and above: three columns, rail 268px | work | inspector 300px.

breakpoints.name: laptop
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: inspector becomes a right drawer; topbar appears.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: one column; rail drawer; sticky topbar; composer docks at the bottom; 44px targets; spectrogram 150px.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: spectrogram 160px with agent tags stepped in three rows; odd axis labels hidden; title 1.3rem; wordmark tracking 0.3em.

layout.wavelengthWindow: 430-665 nm mapped across the band width

narrative.overview:
Spectre reads a run as a spectrogram plate. A charcoal continuum carries bone type, and colour exists only as hairline emission lines at real wavelengths: Scout at 486 nm, Scribe at 546 nm, Warden at the 589 nm sodium doublet, errors at 656 nm. Each agent is one line on a wavelength axis, and its state is the line's form: dashed while pending, solid and glowing while live, half-height when truncated, struck through on failure, doubled when a fallback model answered. The interface is a working instrument, not a chat thread; there are no bubbles, no avatars, no rounded cards.

Density is that of a tool: a fixed three-column workbench (history rail, work area, measurements inspector), condensed grotesque type, tracked uppercase labels and tabular numerals. Everything registers against hairlines and an off-centre vertical calibration rail in the history column. Depth is tonal, from ground to continuum to plate; shadows exist only for things that float. The same mark geometry serves as logo and progress indicator: the brand mark's lines dim, dash and come alive with the pipeline.

Two themes share one structure: the dark "spectrogram plate" (default) and a light "light table" in warm paper tones, where every emission colour is darkened to keep contrast on paper.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal tonal layering, bone text, colour only as 1-2px emission lines, ticks and dashed outlines.
Line form encodes state: dashed, solid, half, struck, doubled.
Square corners everywhere; circles only for magnitude dots and rail terminals.
Condensed grotesque UI (Barlow Semi Condensed) with tracked caps labels; stencil wordmark (Big Shoulders Stencil).
Dashed outline means active, selected or focused.
Motion is physical: a spring overshoot when lines land, an expo ease-out for drawers and sheets.

rules.name: The Hairline Emission Rule
rules.body: Spectral colour is drawn, never filled: lines, ticks, underlines, dashed outlines, text. The only coloured fills are the 10% green wash on the primary button hover and the magnitude dots.

rules.name: The Wavelength Identity Rule
rules.body: Each agent owns its wavelength everywhere it appears (spectrogram, inspector rule, preset labels, mark line): Scout cyan, Scribe green, Warden sodium. Never reassign them.

rules.name: The Paper Darkening Rule
rules.body: In the light theme every line colour is darkened, never reused as-is; the dark-theme hex values fail contrast on paper.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is always tracked (0.1em minimum, 0.22em for labels and buttons). Running text is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Plate Number Rule
rules.body: Runs are named by plate number (`N° 0042`) in meta and history; numerals stay tabular so columns of costs and tokens align.

rules.name: The One Geometry Rule
rules.body: Wavelength position is the only horizontal logic in the spectrogram; agent lines never move to make room, their tags do.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Anything in the grid is flat. Only menus, toasts, dialogs and drawers cast the float shadow.

dos: **Do** draw state as line form (dash, length, count, strike) in the owning agent's wavelength colour.
**Do** mark focus, selection and pressed state with a 1px dashed sodium outline or border (offset 3px for focus-visible).
**Do** give every button its 1px left tick, coloured by meaning.
**Do** keep every surface and control square with 1px hairline borders, and build depth from ground → continuum → plate → plate-2.
**Do** set labels and controls in tracked uppercase Barlow Semi Condensed and numbers in tabular figures.
**Do** reserve the float shadow for menus, toasts, dialogs and drawers.
**Do** use the spring easing for things that land and the expo out easing for things that travel, and respect reduced motion.
**Do** darken every line colour in the light theme rather than reusing dark-theme values.
donts: **Don't** fill surfaces or buttons with spectral colour; colour is a hairline, a tick or text.
**Don't** render runs as chat bubbles, avatars or message threads.
**Don't** round corners on panels, controls or fields; circles are only magnitude dots and rail terminals.
**Don't** give the 405, 436 or 615 nm colours UI meaning; they belong to the mark.
**Don't** reassign an agent's colour or move a line off its wavelength position.
**Don't** use shadows to separate panels inside the grid.
**Don't** set running text in uppercase or set the wordmark in anything but Big Shoulders Stencil.
